name.en: 1D Poisson: Dirichlet sine solution and second-order refinement

scope.ja: 既存Thomas解法で −u''=π²sin(πx) を15/31/63内部点で解き、解析解sin(πx)、独立な差分残差、格子幅半減の次数を別々に確認する。
scope.en: Use the existing Thomas kernel for −u''=π²sin(πx) with 15/31/63 interior nodes; separately check analytic sin(πx), a recomputed discrete residual and halving-grid refinement.

assumptions.ja: 定係数・一様格子の3点差分。入力で領域、境界、右辺、格子、解法を固定。ピボットなしThomasに適した正定値三重対角行列で、任意の三重対角行列を検証するものではない。
assumptions.en: Constant-coefficient three-point differences on a uniform mesh. Inputs fix domain, boundaries, forcing, grids and solver. The SPD tridiagonal system suits unpivoted Thomas; this does not validate arbitrary tridiagonal matrices.

units.ja: 無次元のx∈[0,1]とu。次元を戻すなら[f]=[u]/L²。離散相対残差は格子体積重みなしのEuclideanノルム比。
units.en: Dimensionless x∈[0,1] and u; dimensionally [f]=[u]/L². The relative discrete residual is an unweighted Euclidean norm ratio.

boundaries.en: u(0)=u(1)=0; CSV includes both boundary nodes.

description.ja: CSVは最細格子でx・数値解・解析解・誤差を整列。全3格子の誤差と残差、隣接格子間の次数はresult.jsonに保存。Thomasの原報告は既存台帳でも直接確認未済のため、未検証の一次文献を新たに掲げない。
description.en: CSV aligns finest-grid x, numerical/analytic values and error. JSON retains all three errors/residuals and adjacent-level orders. The Thomas original report remains unverified in the existing catalog, so no newly verified primary-source claim is added.

description.ja: 独立にsin(πx)と右辺を評価する。小残差と連続解誤差は分けて報告する。
description.en: Evaluate sin(πx) and its forcing independently; report continuous-solution error separately from a small discrete residual.

failure_scope.ja: 非零境界、別の右辺、異なる領域や不正格子を拒否。有限差分の滑らかな単一解の検査で、Robin/Neumann、可変係数、ピボットの一般的安全性を保証しない。
failure_scope.en: Reject different forcing/domain, nonzero boundaries and invalid meshes. This smooth finite-difference case does not validate Robin/Neumann data, variable coefficients or general pivot safety.

reference_notes.ja: CSVは最細格子でx・数値解・解析解・誤差を整列。全3格子の誤差と残差、隣接格子間の次数はresult.jsonに保存。Thomasの原報告は既存台帳でも直接確認未済のため、未検証の一次文献を新たに掲げない。
reference_notes.en: CSV aligns finest-grid x, numerical/analytic values and error. JSON retains all three errors/residuals and adjacent-level orders. The Thomas original report remains unverified in the existing catalog, so no newly verified primary-source claim is added.

scope.ja: 自作コードはMIT。入力・数値データ・図・本文はサイトの個別条件に従います。この台帳は利用許諾を拡大しません。
scope.en: Original code is MIT. Inputs, numerical data, figures and prose retain the site’s item-specific terms. This registry does not expand reuse permissions.

description.ja: 63内部点の連続解最大誤差。2次差分の主要誤差π²h²/12に余裕を持つ上限。
description.en: Continuous-solution maximum error at 63 interior nodes; the bound allows margin above the leading π²h²/12 error.

description.ja: 格子幅を半減したときの最大誤差の次数が1.9以上。
description.en: Maximum-error refinement order is at least 1.9 when spacing halves.

description.ja: 独立な差分式で再計算した離散相対残差。離散化誤差とは別の確認。
description.en: Discrete relative residual recomputed with a separate stencil; distinct from discretization error.
Zero Dirichlet values at both endpoints.
SHA-256 of the executed fixed input

description.ja: 入力に記載した条件の合格
description.en: Acceptance conditions in the input passed

title.en: 1D Poisson: Dirichlet sine solution and second-order refinement

outcome.ja: Thomas法の数値解をsin(πx)と比べ、連続解誤差・独立な離散残差・2次格子収束を分けて確認する。
outcome.en: Compare the Thomas solution with sin(πx), separating continuous error, a recomputed discrete residual and second-order grid refinement.

note.ja: 一様格子の3点差分を15/31/63内部点で解く。残差が小さいことと連続解に近いことは別々に判定する。
note.en: Three-point differences on 15/31/63 uniform interior nodes; a small residual and proximity to the continuous solution are separate checks.
